hypotheses.name: Detectability-Weighted PU Learning (negatives trusted only where mapping completeness is high)
layers: Native Bands 2 rtp, 3 tmi_hg, 5 iso_grav_anom_slope, 6 tc, 11 iso_grav_anom_vg (verified signed southward derivative), 13 iso_grav_anom, 15 depth_to_base_surf, 18 iso_grav_anom_hg (verified signed eastward derivative), 19 det_elev_slope (src/gems86/io.py BANDS + BAND_PHYSICS_VERIFIED)
Completeness surface c(x) from Band 15 (shallow basement = mapped-complete) and Band 19 (high slope bedrock exposure = complete), percentile ranks over footprint
hypotheses.physical_signature: HistGradientBoosting PU classifier (positives = catalogue pixels, negatives = sampled background) where each negative's sample_weight = 0.05 + 0.95*c(x): bedrock range fronts (c->1) supply trusted absences, deep covered basins (c->0) supply almost no negative evidence. Features are catalogue-free geophysics only (no distance-to-catalogue, no coordinates), so the surface can fire far from any mapped fault.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Covered-basin faults are unmapped because they are undetectable at the surface, not absent; standard PU treats their habitat as negative evidence and suppresses exactly those predictions (documented fleet failure: GEMSDOE91 S17-LFTG 68.5% of dots <1 km from catalogue).
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Every prior PU/HGB lane (GEMSDOE 6GEMSDOE 0.0286, GEMSDOE91 S17, KSAD) used uniform negative weights; KSAD used completeness only as a post-hoc fusion weight, never as the training sample-weight. No src/gems86_dwpu existed before this session (verified by grep).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Playa/playette basins with genuinely no faults receive inflated scores once negative evidence is discounted; saline playa conductivity (Band 6 TC / radiometric response) can mimic hydrothermal alteration in deep basins.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 1: uncertain sign on catalogue-hide holdout (holdout truth is catalogue-like, favouring propensity learning - a named bias, measured by the E2 unweighted ablation); potential + on SGMC far-field. Frozen gates require E1 > E2 paired and SGMC >= H33 before any download-candidate label.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low-Medium (~20 min CPU: sampled HGB training x2 (visible/full) x3 arms + chunked full-grid prediction at 3730x3292).
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_NOW - training_features.tif restored + SHA-256 verified 2026-10-27 (4371c82e...23bc5, owner mirror via github.com, NOT organizer-authenticated); catalogue/sample are committed bridge files. No new external data.

hypotheses.name: Transient Fluvial Iso-Chi Knickzone Back-Projection (queued H86Q-3/H86R-3, carried forward)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Iso-chi knickzones aligned across >=3 adjacent footwall catchments back-projected down-channel to the B15 bedrock-alluvium step (Perron & Royden 2013), reconstructing buried range-front strands.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Slow-slipping range-front scarps erased by sheetflood aggradation in 20-50 kyr while footwall chi signals persist >0.5 Myr.
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: RLMS used chi pixelwise at the knickpoint (0.5-3 km upslope of the fault); no lane performs catchment-graph down-channel projection. Not run: medium cost (D8 catchment graph) and dem10_chi must be re-pinned in-session.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Resistant welded-tuff/carbonate ledges produce lithologic knickpoints in unfaulted canyons.

hypotheses.name: Geothermal Manifestation Point-Alignment Corridors (RANSAC lines through GDR springs/wells/vents)
layers: DOE GDR submission 1391 wells/springs/vents CSVs (https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391; dist_known_fault unread)
hypotheses.physical_signature: Alignments of >=3 springs/warm wells/vents within a 300 m corridor over >=2 km trace blind permeable strands; score = alignment density x conductivity rank.
hypotheses.why_unmapped: Blind geothermal systems lack surface fault expression but leak fluids/heat along buried structure (INGENIOUS play concept, https://gbcge.org/current-projects/ingenious/).
hypotheses.difference_from_repo: Vents entered prior lanes as pixel covariates; no lane fit explicit point-alignment geometry as the primary surface. Ranked 3: in-footprint point density is low, standalone recall at 37,654 dots implausible.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Well/spring siting follows roads/ranches/range-front water access - cultural alignments.
hypotheses.expected_dti_gain: Rank 3: high precision / very low recall; near-zero standalone HOLDOUT-DTI at full budget.
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: OBTAINABLE - CSVs listed in research/upstream/data_manifest.json (ext_gdr_wellspring_in_footprint), github-mirrored.
